data.one_liner: Check battery optimization status and open settings or disable it on Android.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to query whether the app is ignoring battery optimizations, opens the system battery‑optimization settings, and shows the dialog to request the ignore‑battery‑optimizations permission. It wraps the Android ACTION_REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS intent.
use_when: You need to detect Doze/standby restrictions on Android
You must guide users to disable battery optimization for critical functionality
avoid_when: Running on iOS or other non‑Android platforms
Your app does not require exemption from battery optimizations
strengths: Null‑safety and Android V2 embedding support
weaknesses: Requires manual permission entry in AndroidManifest
May be rejected by Play Store if used without a valid exemption case
